migration.description: Enforce one-to-one binding between a task and a non-null session identifier.

durable_state.description: A session identifier may be bound to at most one task while unbound tasks retain a nullable session_id.
durable_state.storage_implementation: PostgreSQL partial unique index managed by the embedded Goose migration history.

source_compatibility_range.earlier_state: Existing tasks have nullable session_id values and remain readable; the new index is additive.

ordered_operations.description: Create a partial unique index over non-null tasks.session_id values.

rollout_signals: Re-running migration discovery leaves the unique partial index and migration history unchanged.
PostgreSQL rejects a second task binding for the same non-null session identifier.

validation: The index is unique for non-null session_id values and permits multiple null values.
Task state remains readable after database close and reopen.
The migration is immutable and has no backfill or automatic rollback requirement.
